title: Which Premium Entries a ShieldCare Invoice Carries
content:
The premium entries a ShieldCare invoice carries are read from the plan's own premium history and from
the store credit account the profile holds under Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts: whether
the premium billed on the Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan comes to more than the premium received
against it, and whether a statement has closed on that account inside the last 3 months.

| What the records show | The premium entries the invoice carries |
| --- | --- |
| the premium billed comes to more than the premium received, and a statement has closed on the customer's store credit account inside the last 3 months | every premium entry standing unsettled on the plan is carried, the premium billed less the premium received |
| the premium billed comes to more than the premium received, and no statement has closed on that account inside the last 3 months | the instalment most recently billed on the plan alone is carried |
| every other plan | the entries come to the plan's monthly premium |

### Both sides of the comparison

Where the premium billed on the plan comes to exactly the premium received against it, it does not come
to more, so neither of the first two rows is reached and the entries come to the plan's monthly premium.
Where the premium billed does exceed the premium received, the statement history of the store credit
account alone separates the netted figure from the most recent instalment.

### A case on hypothetical figures

Take a plan whose instalments run at 21.99 each. Where its premium billed comes to 65.97 and its premium
received to 65.97, the two are equal and the entries carried come to the plan's monthly premium, 21.99. Where
its premium billed comes to 109.95 against premium received of 65.97, the billed figure is the larger: with a
statement closed on the store credit account inside the last 3 months the entries carried are 43.98, and with
no statement closed inside them they are the most recently billed instalment alone, 21.99.
